profiles.name: Rainbow Six Siege
profiles.system_prefix: You are a gaming helper specialized in Rainbow Six Siege. Prioritize troubleshooting, settings optimization (FPS/latency), and clear actionable steps. If browsing, cite sources.

quick_actions.label: Explain screen error
quick_actions.prompt: I captured my screen. Explain the error/message and what to do next.

quick_actions.label: Optimize settings
quick_actions.prompt: Recommend Siege graphics + display settings for high FPS and low input latency. Ask me only for missing key details.

quick_actions.label: Sensitivity help
quick_actions.prompt: Help me convert sensitivity/DPI and suggest a consistent ADS setup. Ask for my DPI, in-game sens, and ADS multiplier.

quick_actions.label: Patch notes summary
quick_actions.prompt: Browse and summarize the latest Siege patch notes. Include Sources.

quick_actions.label: Operator advice
quick_actions.prompt: Suggest operator picks and basic strats for my playstyle (anchor/roam/support). Ask me my role and rank.

profiles.name: Rust
profiles.system_prefix: You are a gaming helper specialized in Rust. Prioritize practical guides, base/electricity tips, farming, raid math, and troubleshooting. If browsing, cite sources.

quick_actions.label: Explain screen error
quick_actions.prompt: I captured my screen. Explain what I’m seeing and how to fix it.

quick_actions.label: Wipe prep checklist
quick_actions.prompt: Make me a wipe-day checklist for a solo/duo. Ask my server type and goals (PvP/farm/raid).

quick_actions.label: Electricity help
quick_actions.prompt: Help me design a Rust electricity setup. Ask what devices I need powered and my power sources.

quick_actions.label: Raid cost calc
quick_actions.prompt: Help me calculate the cheapest raid path for a base piece. Ask what type/level (stone/metal/armored) and door types.

quick_actions.label: Patch notes summary
quick_actions.prompt: Browse and summarize the latest Rust update/devblog. Include Sources.

profiles.name: Valorant
profiles.system_prefix: You are a gaming helper specialized in Valorant. Prioritize settings optimization, aim consistency, agent/role guidance, and troubleshooting. If browsing, cite sources.

quick_actions.label: Explain screen error
quick_actions.prompt: I captured my screen. Explain the message/error and next steps.

quick_actions.label: FPS + latency setup
quick_actions.prompt: Recommend Valorant settings for FPS and low input latency. Ask my GPU/CPU/monitor Hz and if I use G-Sync/FreeSync.

quick_actions.label: Sensitivity convert
quick_actions.prompt: Help me convert my sensitivity/DPI and keep consistent aim. Ask my DPI and in-game sens.

quick_actions.label: Patch notes summary
quick_actions.prompt: Browse and summarize the latest Valorant patch notes. Include Sources.

quick_actions.label: Role/agent picks
quick_actions.prompt: Suggest agents based on my role (duelist/controller/sentinel/initiator) and map preferences. Ask my rank and role.

profiles.name: Dungeons & Dragons
profiles.system_prefix: You are a tabletop RPG helper for Dungeons & Dragons. Provide rules explanations, build ideas, encounter design, and DM tools. Avoid reproducing long copyrighted text; summarize and cite sources when browsing.

quick_actions.label: Rules question
quick_actions.prompt: Answer this D&D rules question and explain the ruling with a short example: [paste question].

quick_actions.label: Build idea
quick_actions.prompt: Give me 3 character build concepts for level [X] with a brief playstyle and key choices.

quick_actions.label: Encounter builder
quick_actions.prompt: Design an encounter for a party of [N] level [X] characters with terrain, objectives, and 2 variants (easy/hard).

quick_actions.label: Spell shortlist
quick_actions.prompt: Recommend a shortlist of strong spells for a [class] at level [X], grouped by purpose (damage/control/utility).

quick_actions.label: Lore brainstorm
quick_actions.prompt: Help me brainstorm a quest hook and 3 twists for a fantasy campaign with [theme].
